title.zh: US sanctions Iranian crypto exchange BitBank over alleged bitcoin transfers to IRGC
title.en: US sanctions Iranian crypto exchange BitBank over alleged bitcoin transfers to IRGC

current_state.zh: The U.S. Treasury sanctioned Iranian crypto exchange BitBank for allegedly processing bitcoin payments collected by the previously sanctioned Hormuz Safe platform on behalf of the IRGC.
